tools.name: publish_document
tools.description: Publish a PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls), or CSV file as a browser-viewable page, private by default. Accepts filename and base64 content, up to 4 MB decoded. Documents become readable PDFs, slides have presentation controls, and spreadsheets have searchable sheet tabs. Pr

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Identify the AttachPage account connected to this agent.

tools.name: publish_anonymous_page
tools.description: Publish a public web page without an account or API key. It expires in 48 hours. Returns the page URL and a personal claimUrl; opening that link while signed in makes the page permanent.

tools.name: publish_page
tools.description: Publish a web page as the connected user. A siteId replaces an existing page at the same address. preserveFiles retains omitted assets and requires the baseDeploymentId of that version; stale edits are refused. Visibility is private (invitation-only, default) or public. Requires an authenticated Att

tools.name: send_page
tools.description: Email personal invitations for a page to the specified recipient addresses, with an optional message and access expiry. Sends email immediately; sent email cannot be recalled.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the user's pages with recipient and open counts.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Details for one page: address, visibility, recipients and who opened it. Optional filePaths reads exact uploaded source files from that version, up to 20 files and 256 KB total, with text or base64 encoding. An empty filePaths array returns a bounded manifest without file contents.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Rename a page, change its address label (slug), or switch private/public.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Read recipient comments, page paths, pointed-at elements (selector and visible text), and approval or change-request decisions. The status filter selects open, resolved, or all feedback.

tools.name: resolve_feedback
tools.description: Mark recipient feedback as resolved, or reopen it with resolved: false. The recipient sees the updated resolution status.

tools.name: notify_recipients
tools.description: Email existing active recipients that a page has been updated, with an optional note. Each recipient receives a fresh personal link. Sends email immediately; sent email cannot be recalled.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback · Private data: publish_document, publish_anonymous_page, publish_page, get_page, update_page · Public sink: publish_document, publish_anonymous_page, publish_page, send_page, notify_recipients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback · Private data: publish_document, publish_anonymous_page, publish_page, get_page, update_page · Public sink: publish_document, publish_anonymous_page, publish_page, send_page, notify_recipients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
